verdict.rationale: The product documents writing editable skill files into your project, and a runtime probe confirmed a selective install to ./.claude/skills/tdd/. That covers the project-local, repo-committed half of the story. The alternative it offers is a managed, read-only plugin bundle, which is an ownership/update choice, not an explicitly documented user-global scope. missing for 10: documented user-global (all-projects) install scope, an explicit scope flag or choice between local and global, independent corroboration of the global path.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose install scope — project-local files committed with my repo, or user-global across all projects

citations.quote: It writes the skills into your repo as ordinary files you own and can edit.
The installer writes editable files into your project.
selectively installed the single `tdd` skill to ./.claude/skills/tdd/
installs the whole set as a managed, read-only bundle that updates when I ship, so you subscribe rather than fork
